column1: # Range-scan presets (ENABLE_RXJA_PRESET), F+7 or a long 7 on the main screen.
# One per line, tab-separated:
#   name <TAB> lower MHz <TAB> upper MHz <TAB> step kHz <TAB> FM/AM/USB <TAB> W/N
# Both ends are scanned. The step must be one of the radio's steps (2.5, 5,
# 27 bytes and 110 px (full-width char 12 px, ASCII 7 px, half-width kana 6 px).
# 1..9 and 0 on the preset screen pick the first ten, in this order.
# Edit, rerun gen_ja_font.py, upload.py (no firmware rebuild).
# Sources (checked 2026-09-28): 特小 = テレコム チャンネル互換表 5版 (2024.10)
# and RCR STD-20 channel table; air band = 総務省 VHF 航空無線 ナロー化資料
# (Japan still assigns 25 kHz); marine = 国際VHF channel plan; amateur = JARL
# band plan 2025-07-17 (FM segments; 20 kHz is Japanese practice).
# 特定小電力 (voice, 12.5 kHz, analog FM narrow). 単信 L01-L09 / 01-20 incl. the
# 422.1875 control channel (no voice). 中継 pairs are 18.45 MHz apart, so both
# halves are listed (440.2500 / 421.8000 are control channels).
特小 単信
特小 中継 440
特小 中継 421
# aeronautical VHF voice (108-117.975 MHz is navigation, no voice)
エアバンド
# marine VHF: ship transmit / coast station transmit (AIS 161.975, 162.025 left out)
国際VHF 船舶
国際VHF 海岸
# amateur FM (the segments also carry D-STAR / C4FM, which cannot be demodulated)
アマ144 FM
アマ430 FM
アマ430 レピータ
